name: Dhara Rail Projects Limited
summary: Direct railway contracting and a larger AMC mix have lifted reported profit sharply, but four consecutive negative operating-cash-flow years contradict a clean high-quality growth story. Retention, receivables and work-in-progress absorb capital despite tiny fixed assets. IPO funding buys time; it does not prove collections. Watch for cash conversion before treating the headline earnings multiple as cheap. [S1][S2][S4]

score_note: GQS capped 5 for persistent CASH 2; IAS NS.

GOV.reason: Related director loans are interest-free and ownership/transactions disclosed; gratuity adjustments reconcile. Family consultancy, sale of JV stake to director, persistent small statutory delays and incomplete certification response prevent stronger stewardship credit, without establishing diversion.

MOAT.reason: Railway qualifications, technical staff and recurring AMC create barriers. Single ultimate customer ecosystem, tender competition and historical performance disputes limit pricing-power claims.

REV.reason: Preferred five-year parent growth is about 18.7%, within 15–20% band. Recent direct-contract shift and group growth are stronger but small JV disposal and margin/recognition issues caution against trajectory upgrade. Three-year group CAGR disclosed rather than selectively chosen.

DUR.reason: Multi-year maintenance, direct railway orders and working-capital IPO funding support accessible runway. GST-inclusive backlog is not annual revenue and long collection cycle restricts funded growth.

CAP.reason: Asset-light fixed plant masks substantial receivables, retention, WIP and guarantee deposits. Reported incremental NOPAT is strong, but inventory-neutral improvement is only 0.75 crore; durable returns on additional working capital remain mixed, not demonstrated by tiny PPE or headline ROCE.

CASH.reason: Four consecutive negative CFO years, rising retention and aged receivables establish persistent poor cash realization. IPO and deposit release fund operations, not collections. Management expects direct-contract improvement, but it remains unproven; persistent CASH<=3 cap applies.

BAL.reason: IPO has lowered bank debt and funded earmarked working capital, with substantial deposits. Collateral/earmarks, on-demand related loans and recurring cash burn constrain resilience; gross cash is not all surplus.

EXEC.reason: Growing direct contracts and dated awards show delivery and repositioning. Legacy performance terminations, long billing delays and cash deterioration prevent a strong repeatable-execution score.

EARN.reason: Core earnings grew and direct contracting plausibly improves margin, but inventory-change swing exceeds PBT growth, other income inflates management EBITDA, and full-share EPS is lower than weighted annual EPS. Quality is mixed despite high reported PAT.

L.reason: Official 51/60 observed sessions, last trade October 16 with one lot and conservative conditional exit about 10.4 sessions at 5% participation. LotRs 135,000 is 27% of position; no named surveillance match is not depth or unrestricted-exit assurance. Decoded REG 1 also flags fewer than 100 unique PANs and generic SME irregular-trading caution; no forced score change.

sections.title: Executive Verdict
sections.text: Direct railway contracting and a larger AMC mix have lifted reported profit sharply, but four consecutive negative operating-cash-flow years contradict a clean high-quality growth story. Retention, receivables and work-in-progress absorb capital despite tiny fixed assets. IPO funding buys time; it does not prove collections. Watch for cash conversion before treating the headline earnings multiple as cheap. [S1][S2][S4]

sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text: Dhara Rail Projects Limited, DHARARAIL, INE2HJL01019, NSE SME, listed 31 December 2025. Incorporated April 2010 and took over Dhara Industries in July 2010. Consolidated accounts proportionately include 49% DRESPL-DRPPL JV; PE-DRPPL 49% was sold October 2025. Current shares 15,084,000, lot 1,000; last official observed closeRs 135 is October 16, not October 19. Cutoff 20 October 2026, five-year horizon,15% nominal pre-tax hurdle, illustrative Rs 5 lakh position. [S1][S2][S10][S11]

sections.title: Scorecard and Calculation Audit
sections.text: Business and Growth Quality scores are auditable; persistent CASH=2 caps GQS at 5. IAS is NS pending reliable collection/margin normalization and available-cash bridge. The unmodified audit and reconciled cash statement do not remove economic cash-conversion risk. Historical restatement differences are explained, and small disclosure-table errors do not automatically create a critical-reliability hold. [S1][S2][S6]

sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: Railway rolling-stock electrical installation, testing, commissioning and maintenance monetize technicians, tender qualifications and contract management. About 60% AMC mix and a move from OEM subcontracting to direct railway bids are management descriptions. Railway policy, tender economics and payment certification dominate demand and cash collection. Unlike a manufacturer, low PPE does not imply low capital intensity: deposits, retention and project WIP are operating capital. [S2][S4]

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Qualification history and specialized railway electrical maintenance create barriers, while recurring service needs support continuity. Ultimate exposure remains overwhelmingly Indian Railways, and competitors can bid aggressively. Prospectus acknowledges historical terminated/suspended contracts; legacy arbitration evidence prevents an unqualified execution/moat claim. Supplier concentration exceeded 90% for the top ten in FY 2025, with no long-term supply assurance. [S2]

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: Preferred five-year parent revenue grew fromRs 23.8857 crore FY 2021 toRs 56.394 crore FY 2026, about 18.7% CAGR. Group FY 2023–26 revenue 26.60/31.47/44.48/56.74 crore shows recent acceleration. FY 2026 PAT 15.44 crore versus 6.35 crore rose 143%, not merely the approximate doubling in management prose. Core EBITDA excluding other income is 19.93 crore, below management 21.52 crore. The inventory-charge swing of 13.90 crore exceeds the 12.25 crore PBT increase, so margin persistence needs work-completion and collection evidence. [S1][S2][S3][S4]

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text: June backlogRs 184 crore includes GST, with about 95% direct railway work according to management; it is not annual recognized revenue. September 16 awardRs 0.746 crore including GST is a verified six-month electrical job. Multi-year AMCs and fleet electrification support opportunity, but management describes 3–4 months before billing plus 2–3 months for payment. Growth consumes working capital and guarantee deposits before cash returns. IPO funds 23 crore still earmarked for working capital at March, not unrestricted surplus. [S4][S5][S8]

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: March promoter group 73.59% and no pledge/other encumbrance declarations are dated evidence. Two directors receiveRs 0.60 crore remuneration versusRs 0.036 crore prior year; family-office consultancyRs 0.222 crore and JV stake sale to director require attention. Interest-free director loansRs 8.88 crore support funding but are repayable on demand. PF/ESIC arrearsRs 0.163 crore are attributed to employee authentication problems; small financially, but recurrent operational compliance. May filing appoints internal/secretarial auditors, not a statutory-auditor resignation. June certification response is the company position; exchange acceptance is unverified. [S1][S6][S7][S9]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text: Four-year CFO totals minusRs 15.92 crore. FY 2026 receivablesRs 27.18 crore, retentionRs 11.31 crore and WIPRs 8.96 crore are large againstRs 56.74 crore sales. Over-six-month receivables roseRs 0.21 crore toRs 3.37 crore. IPO financing and deposits, not customer cash, drove cash balances. Current WIP P&L/BS differenceRs 0.067 crore is 0.43% of PAT, not by itself material unreliability. Annual share-reconciliation row incorrectly shows 22.1 m shares, but share capital, IPO allotment, official master and ownership corroborate 15.084 m. Prospectus FY 2025 PAT 6.5278 versus annual 6.3501 is a traced gratuity/tax restatement, not unexplained profit. [S1][S2][S5][S7][S11]

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text: At last observedRs 135, equity capitalization isRs 203.63 crore and full-current-share FY 2026 EPS aboutRs 10.24, a 13.2 x headline multiple; weighted EPS 12.75 should not be used unadjusted. Available-cash cases exclude collateral and treat IPO earmarks as future business funding, not all excess cash. Models start from actual operating WC, include future changes once, charge capex, incremental collateral and borrowing interest, and reserve unmodeled GCP spending. Cash restrictions and WIP-driven margin uncertainty are economically material; scenarios are not point targets. [S1][S5][S10][S11] Model correction dated 20 October 2026: the earlier forecast omitted certain opening liabilities excluded from operating working capital. The revised model pays opening net tax and other current claims once, preserves actual opening assets/debt, and explicitly retains noncurrent employee claims in terminal equity with separate settlement sensitivities. This corrects our forecast, not the issuer’s financial statements. No liability is paid twice through working capital, debt, capex or recurring compensation. Corrected bear/base/bull terminal prices are ₹66.60/₹259.26/₹649.31; corresponding five-year returns are -13.18%/13.94%/36.91%. These remain conditional operating and funding scenarios, not executable entry prices. Opening-claim amounts, timing alternatives and annual cash/debt checks are in the model. [S1]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: Persistent delays or failed contracts can trap retention and guarantee cash while on-demand loans remain payable. A25% write-down of WIP plus retention would be aboutRs 5.07 crore pre-tax, roughly 33% of FY 2026 PAT; no impairment is asserted. Severe stress EBITDA at 10% of FY 2026 sales valued 8 x, less debt and adding only cash/current bank, implies roughlyRs 21.4 per share before recovery of restricted deposits, not a price floor. Official observations cover 51 of 60 reference sessions; conditional zero-filled median turnoverRs 9.58 lakh implies 10.4 sessions to exitRs 5 lakh at 5% participation. LotRs 1.35 lakh and one trade on latest date can make real execution much worse. [S1][S10] Official October 19 EOD REG 1, effective October 21, flags fewer than 100 unique PANs traded in the previous 30 days and the generic SME not-regularly-traded caution. The latter is not evidence of additional missing sessions or an automatic L1. These alerts reinforce the existing L4 assessment; no named ESM/ASM/GSM match is not blanket clearance. [S13]

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: Fivefold in five years requires 38.0% annual per-share appreciation; tenfold requires 58.5%. A credible path needs sustained direct-contract growth, retained margin after WIP conversion and materially improved collections, without repeated equity funding. Backlog size or an accounting profit jump alone does not demonstrate those conditions.

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text: Require project-level WIP completion/billing, subsequent receipts and retention release terms. Reconcile restricted versus IPO-funded deposits and utilization after March; update related loan demand terms. Track core margins excluding deposit interest, current-share EPS, work-order cancellations and arbitration outcomes. Obtain exchange acceptance of certification response, resolve PF/ESIC arrears and refresh bid/ask/circuit conditions. Lower quality further if direct contracts fail to shorten cash realization. [S1][S4][S5][S6]

sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text: Deep review covers prospectus history, audited statements, governance, disputes, funding, IPO deployment, current shares, market records and linked sensitivities. Quality scores are medium confidence; IAS is not rankable. Maintain a cash-conversion hold rather than a misconduct allegation or an automatic undervaluation call.

sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Issuer annual reports, final NSE prospectus, official monitoring/clarification, management minutes, dated order and official security/market records support the dossier. FY 2021 revenue note was OCR and visually checked. April additions reviewed in the announcement cache were orders/compliance, not a newly identified acquisition. Current deposit release, complete live depth, post-March utilization and resolution of legacy litigation remain unverified. No named ESM/ASM/GSM match is not universal market clearance.
